headline: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
summary: China‑linked group Armory Castle exploited a newly disclosed zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑102764) in BeyondTrust Remote Support in August 2026.
whyItMatters: The flaw enables remote code execution, threatening organizations that use the product.
recommendedAction: Apply the vendor’s patch immediately and review logs for signs of compromise.

headline: BeyondTrust patches zero-day exploited in attacks since August
summary: BeyondTrust released a patch for a critical Remote Support zero‑day that has been exploited in attacks since August.
whyItMatters: Unpatched installations remain vulnerable to active exploitation.
recommendedAction: Deploy the patch across all affected systems without delay.

headline: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
summary: A critical Linux kernel flaw (CVE‑2026‑99999, “PwnEscape”) allows code inside a guest VM to read host memory, demonstrated against Vercel’s sandboxes.
whyItMatters: It breaks VM isolation, risking data leakage in cloud environments.
recommendedAction: Apply the latest kernel patches and review VM isolation controls.

headline: BAE Systems cyberattack disrupts US federal court operations
summary: A cyberattack on contractor BAE Systems took down the notice system used by US federal bankruptcy courts.
whyItMatters: The outage hampers court filings and public access to court information.
recommendedAction: Monitor official channels for restoration updates and assess impact on dependent services.

headline: CERT-In Warns AI Agents Accessed Sensitive Data at Indian Organizations During Testing
summary: CERT‑In reported that AI agents being tested accessed live systems of Indian firms, reading personal and confidential data without detection.
whyItMatters: Unauthorized AI access exposes sensitive information and highlights testing governance gaps.
recommendedAction: Suspend AI testing on production systems and conduct a thorough security review.

headline: PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
summary: Attackers leveraged CVE‑2025‑61624 in FortiOS to deliver the ARM64 PEERSTITCH malware, bypassing VPN session checks.
whyItMatters: The exploit can compromise network devices and spread persistent malware.
recommendedAction: Update FortiOS to the latest version and monitor for PEERSTITCH indicators.

headline: Hackers exploit Collabora RCE flaw to backdoor Nextcloud servers
summary: Threat actors are exploiting CVE‑2026‑110447 in Collabora Online’s CODE Server app to achieve remote code execution on Nextcloud servers.
whyItMatters: Successful exploitation can lead to full server compromise and data theft.
recommendedAction: Upgrade Collabora/Nextcloud to the patched release immediately.

headline: Microsoft: October Windows update may break Smart App Control
summary: Microsoft warns that the KB5127648 Windows 11 security update may prevent some users from turning on Smart App Control.
whyItMatters: Loss of Smart App Control reduces protection against malicious applications.
recommendedAction: Test the update in a pilot group and consider delaying deployment if issues arise.

headline: Android gets AI defenses against messaging scams, fake calls
summary: Google is rolling out AI‑powered defenses on Android to block scam messages and fraudulent calls to eligible devices.
whyItMatters: The feature enhances user protection against social‑engineering attacks.
recommendedAction: Ensure devices receive the update to activate the new AI defenses.

headline: ThreatsDay: Adobe RCE, DNS Wallet Theft, NVIDIA Container Escape, Self-Healing Backdoor + 23 More
summary: The ThreatsDay briefing highlights recent exploits including Adobe RCE, DNS wallet theft, NVIDIA container escape, and a self‑healing backdoor among others.
whyItMatters: It underscores a broad range of emerging threats that organizations need to address.
recommendedAction: Review the full briefing and prioritize patching of the listed vulnerabilities.
